review.title: Compare two revisions in every diff format

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox
pixel_review.summary: Header clearly identifies main to candidate in Git format. README additions, timeout replacement and first cache hunk remain legible. Red/green patch lines and teal hunk headers are clear; lower content continues beyond the viewport as expected for this first-page checkpoint.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox
text_style_review.summary: Paired 104x36 state has six styles. Header preserves --from main --to candidate --git. Green additions and red removals, including 60 to 120, retain single underline on changed tokens; hunk headings are teal. No plain-text-only inference was used for styling. Repository assertions pass with unchanged working-copy commit and graph.

Adjacent red 60 and green 120 visually distinguish the inline replacement; the caption agrees with the displayed operands.

video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; ffprobe, source tape timing, and sampled ffmpeg contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: ffprobe reports 28.4 seconds, 426 frames at 15 fps. Inspected a 16-frame contact sheet including exact first/last frames, evenly spaced by frame number, against source.tape. The tape provides 22 seconds of visible holds (four 2.5-second checkpoints and six 2-second format waits), two 300ms returns and 70ms typing/transitions, consistent with duration. Samples cover Git range, configured patch, summary, stat, types, name-only, Git again, filled View Options over actual patch content, color-words range, revision patch, deliberate short root-command typing, and final explicit color-words hold. Opening/closing are clean app views, captions track the demonstrated operands, and setup/cleanup is hidden.
